title: About a week or so of developing. And its ready and published
author: Commercial_Grape_789
selftext: First game Iv ever created. And Iv had a lot of fun during the process as well as playing it myself with my son.

replies.author: Commercial_Grape_789
replies.body: It’s called PIXELS OFFSCREEN 🙂 A small browser shooter with wave survival and co-op. I’m a motion designer and this is my first game, so I’d be curious what gave you the Marathon vibe!

replies.author: Nicolas-Gauge
replies.body: My first thought was marathon inspired by looks pretty good

replies.author: Commercial_Grape_789
replies.body: Thanks! 🙂 It’s my first game, so that means a lot. If you give it a go, I’d love to know how the controls feel.

replies.author: MoMotastic_1988
replies.body: Yea man dm me  love to have a go

comments.author: Commercial_Grape_789
comments.body:
Forgot the play link 🙂 It’s PIXELS OFFSCREEN: [https://www.pixelsoffscreen.com/](https://www.pixelsoffscreen.com/)

Free in the browser. You can play solo, with a friend online or with an AI teammate. I’m a motion designer and built it with AI coding tools; I’d love feedback on whether the first wave makes the controls clear.
